build_docmodel_from_config: build a DocModel from a config and tensorizers using the from_config class method
create_docmodel_embedding: create a word embedding module for a DocModel using the create_embedding class method
create_docmodel_decoder: create an MLP decoder for a DocModel with the specified representation dimension and label count
create_docmodel_output_layer: create a classification or regression output layer for a DocModel based on the loss type
torchscriptify_docmodel: torchscriptify a DocModel for optimized inference with optional dense feature support
